race.comment: BEST TERMS (1) resumes after finishing in the money over 1500m at Ballarat five months ago. He didn't miss a placing last time in and has trialled well for the return, very hard to beat up on speed. BLUE VALENTINE (6) is poised to win after placing at her last four outings, most recently when second over 1200m at Mt Gambier. Not much harder here and should go close. SHUJINKO (3) turned in a better run last start, beaten 1.1 lengths into fourth over 1400m at Coleraine. Had a few chances but is going well enough to figure. WHISKEY AND WAR (13) can run well on debut for the Kearney yard. Watch for any market confidence.
